description.value: You understand Runic enough to be able to craft, read, and identify Runes used for equipment with Arcana, even if you do not have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.xWY5omyIcILNR7y1]{Magical Crafting} feat, and you can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Q5iIYCFdqJFM31GW]{Learn a Spell} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} from runes that depict a spell you could learn or infer meaning behind runes you read (such as runes inscribed to enact an effect) after successfully using @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d9gbpiQjChYDYA2L]{Decipher Writing} with Arcana. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.archetypes.SrLwCfO8isJw6W0D]{Runeword: Nefelus, the Torrent of Magic} action, which you can use whenever Farum is charged.
